e.title: Multipopulation-Mortality-Models (TU Munich)
e.summary: 多人口死亡率模型对比论文代码（TU 慕尼黑，Scherer/Ungolo）：意大利社会经济剥夺指数案例
e.body: Multipopulation-Mortality-Models 是 TU 慕尼黑硕士论文《Multi-Population Mortality Models - A Comparison via a Socio-Economic Index of Deprivation on Italian Population》及合作论文《A Neural Network approach for the mortality analysis of multiple populations》（Scherer & Ungolo）的 R 代码：比较多人口死亡率模型（含神经网络方法），用意大利社会经济剥夺指数分层的案例。对 RIAA：多人口死亡率建模（长寿风险的社会经济维度）的完整可复现实现。与 [[mortality-modeling-dav]]（DAV 多人口 NN）、[[affinemortality]]（仿射死亡率）、[[stmomo]]、[[demofit]] 互补。关联 [[longevity]]、[[lifecontingencies]]。

e.summary_en: Paper code comparing multi-population mortality models (TU Munich, Scherer/Ungolo): Italian socio-economic deprivation-index case study
e.summary_hk: 多人口死亡率模型對比論文代碼（TU 慕尼黑，Scherer/Ungolo）：意大利社會經濟剝奪指數案例
e.body_en: Multipopulation-Mortality-Models is the R code of the TU Munich master thesis 'Multi-Population Mortality Models - A Comparison via a Socio-Economic Index of Deprivation on Italian Population' and the cooperating paper 'A Neural Network approach for the mortality analysis of multiple populations' (Scherer & Ungolo): comparing multi-population mortality models (including neural-network approaches) on a case study stratified by the Italian socio-economic deprivation index. For RIAA: a complete reproducible implementation of multi-population mortality modelling (the socio-economic dimension of longevity risk). Complements [[mortality-modeling-dav]] (DAV multi-population NN), [[affinemortality]] (affine mortality), [[stmomo]] and [[demofit]]. Related: [[longevity]], [[lifecontingencies]].
e.body_hk: Multipopulation-Mortality-Models 是 TU 慕尼黑碩士論文《Multi-Population Mortality Models - A Comparison via a Socio-Economic Index of Deprivation on Italian Population》及合作論文《A Neural Network approach for the mortality analysis of multiple populations》（Scherer & Ungolo）的 R 代碼：比較多人口死亡率模型（含神經網絡方法），用意大利社會經濟剝奪指數分層的案例。對 RIAA：多人口死亡率建模（長壽風險的社會經濟維度）的完整可複現實現。與 [[mortality-modeling-dav]]（DAV 多人口 NN）、[[affinemortality]]（仿射死亡率）、[[stmomo]]、[[demofit]] 互補。關聯 [[longevity]]、[[lifecontingencies]]。
